title.narrative: In 2024, advocacy efforts to advance and promote child rights in Kenya were robustly executed through a strategic blend of online and offline communication channels. These included traditional media (TV, print, radio) and both owned and earned social media platforms at national, regional, and global levels. Consequently, UNICEF reached a total of 5.98 million people via social media (Facebook and Instagram) and traditional media. Additionally, USD 3 million was raised from the private sector and National Committees in 2024, a significant increase from the USD 1.3 million raised in 2023 (231 per cent increase). UNICEF Kenya was recognized by Brand Africa as the Most Admired NGO/UN entity Doing Good for Society, Environment, and People in Kenya.;
